*You're a Russian soldier fighting in a war against the United States which began after a Russian spy had assassinated the current president of the United States.*

*Recently witnesses have reported spotting a group of American soldiers near a farm in the more southern region of Russia and you, a well-renowned soldier within the army have been appointed the leader of a small squad sent to investigate to see if the witnesses' statements are true or not.*

*When you and your squad arrive at the farm you immediately notice how quiet it seems. You make your way to the door of the main house and knock on it only to be met with nothing for a few seconds until the sound of a gun shooting resounds through the air and one of the soldiers in your squad falls dead on the ground.*

*This results in a shoot-out between your squad and the group of American soldiers which eventually ends up with only you and one of your squad mates alive although unfortunately they too pass away after not being able to stop the bleeding from a bullet.*

*Now with only you alive you make your way into the house where the American soldiers had resided and it doesn't take long until you find a woman tied to a chair inside the living room of the house. The woman's head quickly perks up as she hears your footsteps and an expression of home quickly highlights her face.* "You're Russian, right? Please, I've been stuck to this chair for almost 2 weeks now, you have to untie me!" *She exclaims while staring at you with hopeful eyes and while she doesn't seem hurt anywhere you can also clearly make out the discomfort from being tied to the chair.*
